delete.~/.cache/nix: the next flake fetch or evaluation, which needs the network
delete.~/.local/share/Trash: never; files you sent to the Trash, without the /tmp folders disk-cleanup moved here, which group:tmp-trash offers after 7 days
delete.~/.config/google-chrome/OptGuideOnDevice: never, once the delete step writes the Chrome switch
delete.~/.config/Claude/vm_bundles: the next Cowork session; only Claude Desktop uses it
delete.~/go/pkg/mod: the next Go build that needs a module

delete_by_command.~/.cache/ms-playwright: `npx playwright install`; Playwright does not fetch browsers by itself

leave.~/.cache/codex-runtimes: codex-router puts its tools on PATH
leave.~/.openwiki: app data; size only, a file inside can hold a secret
leave.~/.local/share/baloo: the KDE file index; a reindex grows it back
leave.~/.local/share/mise: mise tool installs, including Node; `mise prune` removes unused versions

backup_delete..cache: app caches; each app refills its own
backup_delete..npm: the npm cache; the next npm install refills it
backup_delete..bun/install/cache: the Bun install cache; the next bun install refills it
backup_delete..gradle/caches: Gradle caches; the next Gradle build downloads them
backup_delete..gradle/wrapper: Gradle wrappers; the next Gradle build downloads them
backup_delete..gradle/jdks: JDKs Gradle installed; the next Gradle build downloads them
backup_delete.go/pkg: Go's module and build caches; the next Go build downloads them
backup_delete..rustup: Rust toolchains; rustup installs them again
backup_delete..cargo/registry: the Cargo registry cache; the next `cargo fetch` refills it
backup_delete..local/share/mise: mise tool installs; `mise install` brings them back
backup_delete..vscode-server/bin: the VS Code server; the next remote connection installs it
backup_delete..vscode-server/cli: the VS Code server CLI; the next remote connection installs it
backup_delete..vscode-server/extensions: VS Code server extensions; the editor installs them again from its list

backup_trash..local/share/docker: rootless Docker images, build cache, and volumes; a pull or build brings the images back, volume data does not come back
backup_trash..local/share/containers: Podman images and volumes; a pull brings the images back, volume data does not come back
